MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful next addition to my Fire TV setup because it adds a larger Alexa display for home controls and video calling.",
    "The smart plug fits my interest in connected home devices by giving me a practical new use: controlling a lamp by voice."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little when I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television.",
    "Earbuds and car-based Alexa do not address my current interest in home viewing and connected devices.",
    "Owning cameras does not mean I currently need a 16TB drive, and my monitor purchase does not imply a planned internal storage upgrade."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My use of Alexa-enabled devices seems to have been taken as interest in Alexa products for every setting, including the car.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in accessories, without a clear purpose connecting earbuds or large drives to my current needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a new device needs to add a useful capability beyond my existing viewing setup.",
    "Several Alexa devices interest me, but I would choose one larger display this visit rather than also selecting smaller displays and speakers.",
    "Storage capacity needs a specific use and a current need; video recording alone does not make a very large drive appealing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in a connected home but stretched it into redundant viewing devices and electronics without a current purpose."
}
